columns.name: n_regionkey
columns.description: The region key of the nation.

columns.name: num_suppliers_in_debt
columns.description: The number of suppliers whose accounts are in debt in the nation, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: num_customers
columns.description: The number of customers come from the nation, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: balance_larger_thant_avg_balance
columns.description: Set to 1 if the average account balance of the customers in the nation is larger than the average account balance across all customers, otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: total_price_of_all_orders
columns.description: The total price of all orders from the nation, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: per_indebted_suppliers
columns.description: The percentage of suppliers whose accounts are in debt in the nation

columns.name: c_nationkey
columns.description: The nation key of the customer.

columns.name: num_orders
columns.description: The number of orders the customer has made, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: average_total_price_per_order
columns.description: The average total price per order the customer has made.

columns.name: has_above_average_account_balance
columns.description: Set to 1 if the account balance of the customer is above the average account balance of all customers, otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: order_date_highest_total_price
columns.description: The order date with the highest total price the customer has made, with ties broken by the ascending order of the order date.

columns.name: balance_lower_than_4000_and_in_US
columns.description: Set to 1 if the account balance of the customer is lower than 4000 and the customer is from the US, otherwise, set to 0
